configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.description: Builds the ASC core and unittester; run via scripts/build-core.sh, which fetches vcpkg into build/vcpkg and sets VCPKG_ROOT.

configurePresets.name: macos-sanitizers
configurePresets.description: Like macos, but instrumented with ASan and UBSan in build/core-sanitizers (QA measure S2, doc/qameasures.md); run via scripts/build-core.sh --sanitizers.

configurePresets.name: macos-coverage
configurePresets.displayName: macOS with code coverage of the facade
configurePresets.description: Like macos, but the facade is compiled with coverage instrumentation, in build/core-coverage (QA measure S7, doc/qameasures.md); run via scripts/build-core.sh --coverage.
